title: ida cinnabarina
intro: Ida cinnabarina, commonly known as the Red Cinnabar, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It is a rare and endangered plant, primarily found in the mountainous regions of China. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Ida cinnabarina include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of calming the mind, reducing stress, and promoting overall well-being.
